question: Is it true that you shoot out a "Coup de Boo" when you eat potatoes? by Modai
answer: OH YES. I DO. Man, let me tell you. I accidentally ate a potato last time, and one single "Coup de Boo" sent me flying to New York. It was Coup de Booman in New York. Of course, I was able to get a potato to send me back home safely.
name: Modai
